subject.title: fix: before_agent_run transform no longer leaks redacted text into history

question: Should `before_agent_run` gain a public `transform` outcome whose replacement becomes the canonical persisted user turn, rather than remaining a model-only transformation or requiring plugins to block the run?
rationale: This choice defines an external plugin API and determines whether OpenClaw intentionally replaces user-authored transcript content, with compatibility, auditing, session-state, and security consequences that code review alone cannot settle.

options.title: Canonical redaction contract
options.body: Approve persisted transforms after the current-turn ownership bug is fixed, direct Codex behavior is inspected, compatibility tests are added, and live embedded/CLI proof is posted.

options.title: Model-only transformation
options.body: Keep the original canonical transcript and expose transformed text only at model-bound and explicitly approved observer surfaces, with documentation warning that later history can restore the original text.

options.title: Do not add transform
options.body: Retain pass/block only and require privacy plugins to block sensitive turns until a narrower redaction architecture is designed.

recommendation.title: Canonical redaction contract
recommendation.body: Approve persisted transforms after the current-turn ownership bug is fixed, direct Codex behavior is inspected, compatibility tests are added, and live embedded/CLI proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily changes the public plugin hook outcome and lifecycle contract in the hook-runner area.
